concerns.text: Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires a task that records SHA‑256 checksums of all raw data files (e.g., the downloaded OTU table and serology CSV). No such task exists in the current task list, leaving the project unable to verify data integrity.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) mandates that random seeds be pinned in all scripts. There is no dedicated task that enforces or documents seed setting across the codebase, risking non‑reproducible runs.
